label: Bible Study
prompt: The _____ withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
verse: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
note: Everything green fades eventually — the word of God is the one thing that doesn't.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: He is not here: for he is _____, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
verse: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
note: The angel's Easter sermon is short: he is not here, he is risen, come and see. Best news ever preached.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as _____, and so we were in their sight.
verse: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
note: Ten of the twelve spies saw giants and felt like grasshoppers — and that self-image cost Israel forty years.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Behold upon the mountains the _____ of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.
verse: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.
note: Good news for Judah: Nineveh the oppressor is finished — Isaiah 52:7 paints nearly the same picture.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the _____ of the sea.
verse: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
note: Sins cast into 'the depths of the sea' — Corrie ten Boom added that God then posts a sign: No Fishing Allowed.
